shloka_text: स तु दत्त्वा दशग्रीवो वनं घोरं स्वरस्य तत् । भगिनीं च समाश्वास्य हृष्टः स्वस्थतरो ऽभवत् ।। 7.25.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tu dattvā daśagrīvo vanaṃ ghoraṃ svarasya tat | bhaginīṃ ca samāśvāsya hṛṣṭaḥ svasthataro 'bhavat || 7.25.1 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, दत्त्वा having given, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), वनम् forest, घोरम् terrible, खरस्य to Khara, तत् that, भगिनीम् sister, च and, समाश्वास्य having consoled, हृष्टः delighted, स्वस्थतरः more at ease, अभवत् became.
explanation: Having given that terrible forest to Khara and having consoled his sister, Dashagriva became delighted and more at ease.
comments: At Lanka Ravana finds his son Meghanada (Indrajit) completing seven great sacrifices, having won from Shiva a sky-faring chariot, the illusion Tamasi, and inexhaustible weapons -- Vibhishana reveals that the demon Madhu has meanwhile carried off their kinswoman Kumbhinasi -- Ravana marches on Madhupura, but Kumbhinasi, now Madhu's wife, begs him to spare her husband, and Madhu joins his campaign as they encamp at Kailasa.

shloka_text: ततो निकुम्भिला नाम लङ्कोपवनमुत्तमम् । तद्राक्षसेन्द्रो बलवान्प्रविवेश सहानुगः ।। 7.25.2 ।।
transliteration: tato nikumbhilā nāma laṅkopavanamuttamam | tadrākṣasendro balavānpraviveśa sahānugaḥ || 7.25.2 ||
translation: ततः then, निकुम्भिला Nikumbhila, नाम named, लङ्का of Lanka, उपवनम् pleasure grove, उत्तमम् excellent, तत् that, राक्षसेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas (Ravana), बलवान् powerful, प्रविवेश entered, सह with, अनुगः followers.
explanation: Then, the powerful king of Rakshasas, Ravana, entered that excellent pleasure grove of Lanka named Nikumbhila, along with his followers.

shloka_text: ततो यूपशताकीर्णं सौम्यचैत्योपशोभितम् । ददर्श विष्ठितं यज्ञं श्रिया सम्प्रज्वलन्निव ।। 7.25.3 ।।
transliteration: tato yūpaśatākīrṇaṃ saumyacaityopaśobhitam | dadarśa viṣṭhitaṃ yajñaṃ śriyā samprajvalanniva || 7.25.3 ||
translation: ततः then, यूपशताकीर्णम् filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts, सौम्यचैत्योपशोभितम् adorned with auspicious altars, ददर्श he saw, विष्ठितम् established, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, श्रिया with splendor, सम्प्रज्वलन्निव as if blazing forth.
explanation: Then, he saw the established sacrifice, which was filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts and adorned with auspicious altars, appearing as if it was blazing forth with splendor.

shloka_text: ततः कृष्णाजिनधरं कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम् । ददर्श स्वसुतं तत्र मेघनादं भयावहम् ।। 7.25.4 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ kamaṇḍaluśikhādhvajam | dadarśa svasutaṃ tatra meghanādaṃ bhayāvaham || 7.25.4 ||
translation: ततः then, कृष्णाजिनधरम् wearing a black deer skin, कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम् with a water-pot and a top-knot as his emblem, ददर्श he saw, स्वसुतम् his own son, तत्र there, मेघनादम् Meghanada, भयावहम् formidable.
explanation: Then, he saw his own formidable son, Meghanada, there, wearing a black deer skin and distinguished by his water-pot and top-knot.

shloka_text: तं समासाद्य लङ्केशः परिष्वज्वाथ बाहुभिः । अब्रवीत्किमिदं वत्स वर्तसे ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः ।। 7.25.5 ।।
transliteration: taṃ samāsādya laṅkeśaḥ pariṣvajvātha bāhubhiḥ | abravītkimidaṃ vatsa vartase brūhi tattvataḥ || 7.25.5 ||
translation: तम् him, समासाद्य having approached, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, परिष्वज्वाथ and having embraced, बाहुभिः with his arms, अब्रवीत् he said, किमिदम् what is this, वत्स my son, वर्तसे you are doing, ब्रूहि tell me, तत्त्वतः truly.
explanation: Having approached and embraced him with his arms, Ravana, the lord of Lanka, asked, "My son, what is this you are doing? Tell me the truth."

shloka_text: उशना त्वब्रवीत्तत्र यज्ञसम्पत्समृद्धये । रावणं राक्षसश्रेष्ठं द्विजश्रेष्ठो महातपाः ।। 7.25.6 ।।
transliteration: uśanā tvabravīttatra yajñasampatsamṛddhaye | rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭho mahātapāḥ || 7.25.6 ||
translation: उशना Ushana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् he said, तत्र there, यज्ञसम्पत्समृद्धये for the prosperity of the sacrificial wealth, रावणम् to Ravana, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् the best of Rakshasas, द्विजश्रेष्ठः the best of Brahmins, महातपाः of great penance.
explanation: There, Ushana, the best of Brahmins and of great penance, spoke to Ravana, the best of Rakshasas, regarding the successful completion of the sacrifice.

shloka_text: अहमाख्यामि ते राजञ्छ्रूयतां सर्वमेव तत् । यज्ञास्ते सप्त पुत्रेण प्राप्तास्सुबहुविस्तराः ।। 7.25.7 ।।
transliteration: ahamākhyāmi te rājañchrūyatāṃ sarvameva tat | yajñāste sapta putreṇa prāptāssubahuvistarāḥ || 7.25.7 ||
translation: अहम् I, आख्यामि will tell, ते to you, राजन् O King, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, सर्वम् all, एव indeed, तत् that, यज्ञाः sacrifices, ते your, सप्त seven, पुत्रेण by your son, प्राप्ताः attained, सुबहुविस्तराः very extensive.
explanation: Ushana then said, "O King, I will tell you all about it; listen, for your son has completed seven very extensive sacrifices."

shloka_text: अग्निष्टोमो ऽश्वमेधश्च यज्ञो बहुसुवर्णकः । राजसूयस्तथा यज्ञो गोमेधो वैष्ववस्तथा ।। 7.25.8 ।।
transliteration: agniṣṭomo 'śvamedhaśca yajño bahusuvarṇakaḥ | rājasūyastathā yajño gomedho vaiṣvavastathā || 7.25.8 ||
translation: अग्निष्टोमः Agnishtoma, अश्वमेधः Ashwamedha, च and, यज्ञः sacrifice, बहुसुवर्णकः Bahusuvarnaka, राजसूयः Rajasuya, तथा and also, यज्ञः sacrifice, गोमेधः Gomedha, वैष्ववः Vaishvava, तथा and also.
explanation: The Agnishtoma, Ashwamedha, Bahusuvarnaka, Rajasuya, Gomedha, and Vaishvava are all types of sacrifices.

shloka_text: माहेश्वरे प्रवृत्ते तु यज्ञे पुम्भिः सुदुर्लभे । वरांस्ते लब्धवान्पुत्रः साक्षात्पशुपतेरिह ।। 7.25.9 ।।
transliteration: māheśvare pravṛtte tu yajñe pumbhiḥ sudurlabhe | varāṃste labdhavānputraḥ sākṣātpaśupateriha || 7.25.9 ||
translation: माहेश्वरे in the Maheswara, प्रवृत्ते when commenced, तु indeed, यज्ञे sacrifice, पुम्भिः by men, सुदुर्लभे very difficult to perform, वरान् boons, ते your, लब्धवान् obtained, पुत्रः son, साक्षात् directly, पशुपतेः from Pashupati, इह here.
explanation: When the Maheswara sacrifice, which is very difficult for men to perform, was commenced, your son directly obtained boons from Pashupati (Lord Shiva) here.

shloka_text: कामगं स्यन्दनं दिव्यमन्तरिक्षचरं ध्रुवम् । मायां च तामसीं नाम यया सम्पद्यते तमः ।। 7.25.10 ।।
transliteration: kāmagaṃ syandanaṃ divyamantarikṣacaraṃ dhruvam | māyāṃ ca tāmasīṃ nāma yayā sampadyate tamaḥ || 7.25.10 ||
translation: कामगम् moving at will, स्यन्दनम् a chariot, दिव्यम् divine, अन्तरिक्षचरम् moving in the sky, ध्रुवम् firm, मायाम् illusion, च and, तामसीम् Tamasi, नाम named, यया by which, सम्पद्यते is produced, तमः darkness.
explanation: He obtained a divine chariot that moves at will, travels in the sky, and is firm, and also an illusion named Tamasi, by which darkness is produced.

shloka_text: एतया किल सङ्ग्रामे मायया राक्षसेश्वर । प्रयुक्तया गतिः शक्या नहि ज्ञातुं सुरासुरैः ।। 7.25.11 ।।
transliteration: etayā kila saṅgrāme māyayā rākṣaseśvara | prayuktayā gatiḥ śakyā nahi jñātuṃ surāsuraiḥ || 7.25.11 ||
translation: एतया by this, किल indeed, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, मायया by illusion, राक्षसेश्वर O Lord of Rakshasas, प्रयुक्तया when employed, गतिः movement, शक्या possible, न not, हि indeed, ज्ञातुम् to know, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras.
explanation: O Lord of Rakshasas, it is said that when this illusion is employed in battle, its movement cannot indeed be ascertained by even gods and asuras.

shloka_text: अक्षयाविषुधी बाणैश्चापं चापि सुदुर्जयम् । अस्त्रं च बलवद्राजञ्छत्रुविध्वंसनं रणे ।। 7.25.12 ।।
transliteration: akṣayāviṣudhī bāṇaiścāpaṃ cāpi sudurjayam | astraṃ ca balavadrājañchatruvidhvaṃsanaṃ raṇe || 7.25.12 ||
translation: अक्षयाविषुधी two inexhaustible quivers, बाणैः with arrows, चापम् a bow, च and, अपि also, सुदुर्जयम् very difficult to conquer, अस्त्रम् a weapon, च and, बलवत् powerful, राजन् O King, शत्रुविध्वंसनम् destroyer of enemies, रणे in battle.
explanation: O King, he also obtained two inexhaustible quivers with arrows, a bow that is very difficult to conquer, and a powerful weapon that destroys enemies in battle.

shloka_text: एतान्सर्वान्वरांल्लब्ध्वा पुत्रस्ते ऽयं दशानन । अद्य यज्ञसमाप्तौ च त्वां दिदृक्षुस्स्थितो ह्यहम् ।। 7.25.13 ।।
transliteration: etānsarvānvarāṃllabdhvā putraste 'yaṃ daśānana | adya yajñasamāptau ca tvāṃ didṛkṣussthito hyaham || 7.25.13 ||
translation: दशानन O Dashanana, एतान् सर्वान् all these, वरान् boons, लब्ध्वा having obtained, ते अयं पुत्रः this son of yours, अद्य today, यज्ञसमाप्तौ at the conclusion of the sacrifice, त्वां you, दिदृक्षुः desiring to see, स्थितः हि अहम् I indeed stand here.
explanation: Having obtained all these boons, O Dashanana, your son, now that the sacrifice is concluded, and I myself, stand here eager to behold you.

shloka_text: ततो ऽब्रवीदृशग्रीवो न शोभनमिदं कृतम् । पूजिताः शत्रवो यस्माद्द्रव्यैरिन्द्रपुरोगमाः ।। 7.25.14 ।।
transliteration: tato 'bravīdṛśagrīvo na śobhanamidaṃ kṛtam | pūjitāḥ śatravo yasmāddravyairindrapurogamāḥ || 7.25.14 ||
translation: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, न not, शोभनम् good, इदम् this, कृतम् done, पूजिताः worshipped, शत्रवः enemies, यस्मात् because, द्रव्यैः with wealth, इन्द्रपुरोगमाः Indra and others.
explanation: Then Dashagriva spoke, saying that this was not good because the enemies, led by Indra, had been honored with wealth.

shloka_text: एहीदानीं कृतं विद्धि सुकृतं तन्न संशयः । आगच्छ सौम्य गच्छामः स्वमेव भवनं प्रति ।। 7.25.15 ।।
transliteration: ehīdānīṃ kṛtaṃ viddhi sukṛtaṃ tanna saṃśayaḥ | āgaccha saumya gacchāmaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ prati || 7.25.15 ||
translation: एहि come, इदानीम् now, कृतम् done, विद्धि know, सुकृतम् well-done, तत् that, न no, संशयः doubt, आगच्छ come, सौम्य O gentle one, गच्छामः let us go, स्वम् own, एव indeed, भवनम् house, प्रति towards.
explanation: Come now, know that what is done is well done, there is no doubt about it; come, O gentle one, let us go to our own abode.

shloka_text: ततो गत्वा दशग्रीवः सपुत्रः सविभीषणः । स्त्रियो ऽवतारयामास सर्वास्ता बाष्पगद्गदाः ।। 7.25.16 ।।
transliteration: tato gatvā daśagrīvaḥ saputraḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ | striyo 'vatārayāmāsa sarvāstā bāṣpagadgadāḥ || 7.25.16 ||
translation: ततः then, गत्वा having gone, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सपुत्रः with his sons, सविभीषणः with Vibhishana, स्त्रियः women, अवतारयामास made to descend, सर्वाः all, ताः those, बाष्पगद्गदाः choked with tears.
explanation: Then, having gone, Dashagriva, along with his sons and Vibhishana, brought down all those women who were choked with tears.

shloka_text: लक्षिण्यो रत्नभूताश्च देवदानवरक्षसाम् । तस्य तासु मतिं ज्ञात्वा धर्मत्मा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। 7.25.17 ।।
transliteration: lakṣiṇyo ratnabhūtāśca devadānavarakṣasām | tasya tāsu matiṃ jñātvā dharmatmā vākyamabravīt || 7.25.17 ||
translation: लक्षिण्यः auspicious, रत्नभूताः jewel-like, च and, देवदानवरक्षसाम् of gods, Danavas, and Rakshasas, तस्य his, तासु in them, मतिम् intention, ज्ञात्वा having known, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Knowing his intention towards those auspicious, jewel-like women of gods, Danavas, and Rakshasas, the righteous one (Vibhishana) spoke these words.

shloka_text: ईदृशैस्त्वं समाचारैर्यशोर्थकुलनाशनैः । धर्षणं ज्ञातिनां ज्ञात्वा स्वमतेन विचेष्टसे ।। 7.25.18 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśaistvaṃ samācārairyaśorthakulanāśanaiḥ | dharṣaṇaṃ jñātināṃ jñātvā svamatena viceṣṭase || 7.25.18 ||
translation: ईदृशैः with such, त्वम् you, समाचारैः actions, यशः fame, अर्थ wealth, कुल family, नाशनैः destroying, धर्षणम् insult, ज्ञातिनाम् of relatives, ज्ञात्वा having known, स्वमतेन by your own will, विचेष्टसे you act.
explanation: You act by your own will with such conduct that destroys fame, wealth, and family, even though you know it is an outrage to your kinsmen.

shloka_text: ज्ञातींस्तान्धर्षयित्वेमास्त्वया ऽ ऽनीता वराङ्गनाः । त्वामतिक्रम्य मधुना राजन्कुम्भीनसी हृता ।। 7.25.19 ।।
transliteration: jñātīṃstāndharṣayitvemāstvayā ' 'nītā varāṅganāḥ | tvāmatikramya madhunā rājankumbhīnasī hṛtā || 7.25.19 ||
translation: ज्ञातीन् relatives, तान् those, धर्षयित्वा having humiliated, इमाः these, त्वया by you, आनीताः brought, वराङ्गनाः beautiful women, त्वाम् you, अतिक्रम्य having transgressed, मधुना by Madhu, राजन् O King, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, हृता abducted.
explanation: O King, while you brought these beautiful women after humiliating their kinsmen, Madhu has abducted Kumbhinasi, disregarding your authority.

shloka_text: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं नावगच्छामि किं त्विदम् । को ऽयं यस्तु त्वया ऽ ऽख्यातो मधुरित्येव नामतः ।। 7.25.20 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastvabravīdvākyaṃ nāvagacchāmi kiṃ tvidam | ko 'yaṃ yastu tvayā ' 'khyāto madhurityeva nāmataḥ || 7.25.20 ||
translation: रावणः Ravana, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, वाक्यम् a word, न not, अवगच्छामि I understand, किम् what, तु indeed, इदम् this, कः who, अयम् this, यः who, तु indeed, त्वया by you, आख्यातः mentioned, मधुः Madhu, इति thus, एव indeed, नामतः by name.
explanation: Ravana then spoke, saying, "I do not understand what this is; who is this person named Madhu whom you have mentioned?"

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् । श्रूयतामस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमागतम् ।। 7.25.21 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu saṅkruddho bhrātaraṃ vākyamabravīt | śrūyatāmasya pāpasya karmaṇaḥ phalamāgatam || 7.25.21 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, भ्रातरम् to his brother, वाक्यम् a word, अब्रवीत् said, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, अस्य of this, पापस्य sinful, कर्मणः deed, फलम् fruit, आगतम् arrived.
explanation: But Vibhishana, greatly enraged, spoke to his brother, saying, "Listen, the consequence of this sinful deed has arrived."

shloka_text: मातामहस्य यो भ्राता ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सुमालिनः । माल्यवानिति विख्यातो वृद्धः प्राज्ञो निशाचरः ।। 7.25.22 ।।
transliteration: mātāmahasya yo bhrātā jyeṣṭho bhrātā sumālinaḥ | mālyavāniti vikhyāto vṛddhaḥ prājño niśācaraḥ || 7.25.22 ||
translation: मातामहस्य of the maternal grandfather, यः who, भ्राता brother, ज्येष्ठः elder, भ्राता brother, सुमालिनः of Sumali, माल्यवान् Malyavan, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, वृद्धः old, प्राज्ञः wise, निशाचरः night-wanderer.
explanation: Malyavan, the elder brother of Sumali, who is our maternal grandfather's brother, is a renowned, old, and wise Rakshasa.

shloka_text: पिता ज्येष्ठो जनन्या नो ह्यस्माकं चार्यको ऽभवत् । तस्य कुम्भीनसी नाम दुहितुर्दुहिता ऽभवत् ।। 7.25.23 ।।
transliteration: pitā jyeṣṭho jananyā no hyasmākaṃ cāryako 'bhavat | tasya kumbhīnasī nāma duhiturduhitā 'bhavat || 7.25.23 ||
translation: पिता father, ज्येष्ठः elder, जनन्याः of mother, नः our, हि indeed, अस्माकम् our, च and, आर्यकः maternal grandfather, अभवत् was, तस्य his, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, नाम named, दुहितुः of the daughter, दुहिता daughter, अभवत् was.
explanation: He was indeed the elder father of our mother, and thus our maternal grandfather, and his daughter's daughter was named Kumbhinasi.

shloka_text: मातृष्वसुरथास्माकं सा च कन्या ऽनलोद्भवा । भवत्यस्माकमेवैषा भ्रातृणां धर्मतः स्वसा ।। 7.25.24 ।।
transliteration: mātṛṣvasurathāsmākaṃ sā ca kanyā 'nalodbhavā | bhavatyasmākamevaiṣā bhrātṛṇāṃ dharmataḥ svasā || 7.25.24 ||
translation: मातृष्वसुः of our mother's sister, अथ and, अस्माकम् our, सा she, च and, कन्या daughter, अनलोद्भवा born of Anala, भवति becomes, अस्माकम् our, एव indeed, एषा this, भ्रातृणाम् of brothers, धर्मतः by dharma, स्वसा sister.
explanation: She, the daughter born of Anala, is our mother's sister's daughter, and thus by dharma, she is indeed our sister.

shloka_text: सा हृता, मधुना राजन्राक्षसेन बलीयसा । यज्ञप्रवृत्ते पुत्रे तु मयि चान्तर्जलोषिते ।। 7.25.25 ।।
transliteration: sā hṛtā, madhunā rājanrākṣasena balīyasā | yajñapravṛtte putre tu mayi cāntarjaloṣite || 7.25.25 ||
translation: सा She, हृता was abducted, मधुना by Madhu, राजन् O King, राक्षसेन by the demon, बलीयसा powerful, यज्ञप्रवृत्ते engaged in a sacrifice, पुत्रे when my son (was), तु but, मयि I (was), च and, अन्तर्जलोषिते dwelling inside water.
explanation: O King, she was abducted by the powerful demon Madhu while my son was engaged in a sacrifice and I was dwelling in penance underwater.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णे महाराज निद्रामनुभवत्यथ । निहत्य राक्षसश्रेष्ठानमात्यानिह सम्मतान् ।। 7.25.26 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇe mahārāja nidrāmanubhavatyatha | nihatya rākṣasaśreṣṭhānamātyāniha sammatān || 7.25.26 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णे when Kumbhakarna (was), महाराज O great king, निद्राम् sleep, अनुभवति experiencing, अथ then, निहत्य having killed, राक्षसश्रेष्ठान् the best of demons, अमात्यान् ministers, इह here, सम्मतान् respected.
explanation: O great king, at that time, while Kumbhakarna was experiencing his long sleep, Madhu killed the best and most respected demon ministers here.

shloka_text: धर्षयित्वा हृता सा तु सुप्ताप्यन्तःपुरे तव । श्रुत्वा ऽपि तन्महाराज क्षान्तमेव हतो न सः ।। 7.25.27 ।।
transliteration: dharṣayitvā hṛtā sā tu suptāpyantaḥpure tava | śrutvā 'pi tanmahārāja kṣāntameva hato na saḥ || 7.25.27 ||
translation: धर्षयित्वा having violated, हृता was abducted, सा she, तु but, सुप्ता sleeping, अपि even, अन्तःपुरे in the inner chambers, तव your, श्रुत्वा having heard, अपि even, तत् that, महाराज O great king, क्षान्तम् forgiven, एव indeed, हतः killed, न not, सः he.
explanation: She was abducted after being violated, even while sleeping in your inner chambers, yet, O great king, even after hearing of that, he was indeed forgiven and not killed.

shloka_text: यस्मादवश्यं दातव्या कन्या भर्त्रे हि भ्रातृभिः । तदेतत्कर्मणो ह्यस्य फलं पापस्य दुर्मते ।। 7.25.28 ।।
transliteration: yasmādavaśyaṃ dātavyā kanyā bhartre hi bhrātṛbhiḥ | tadetatkarmaṇo hyasya phalaṃ pāpasya durmate || 7.25.28 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, अवश्यम् certainly, दातव्या to be given, कन्या a daughter, भर्त्रे to the husband, हि indeed, भ्रातृभिः by brothers, तत् that, एतत् this, कर्मणः of the action, हि indeed, अस्य his, फलम् fruit, पापस्य of the sinful, दुर्मते O evil-minded one.
explanation: Because a daughter must indeed be given to her husband by her brothers, this, O evil-minded one, is truly the consequence of his sinful act.

shloka_text: अस्मिन्नेवाभिसम्प्राप्तं लोके विदितमस्तु ते । विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रः स रावणः । दौरात्म्येनात्मनोद्धूतस्तप्ताम्भ इव सागरः ।। 7.25.29 ।।
transliteration: asminnevābhisamprāptaṃ loke viditamastu te | vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendraḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ | daurātmyenātmanoddhūtastaptāmbha iva sāgaraḥ || 7.25.29 ||
translation: अस्मिन् in this, एव indeed, अभिसम्प्राप्तम् arrived, लोके in the world, विदितम् known, अस्तु let it be, ते to you, विभीषणवचः Vibhishana's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राक्षसेन्द्रः king of demons, सः that, रावणः Ravana, दौरात्म्येन by wickedness, आत्मना by himself, उद्धूतः agitated, तप्ताम्भः hot water, इव like, सागरः ocean.
explanation: Let it be known to you that upon hearing Vibhishana's words, that king of demons Ravana was agitated by his own wickedness, like an ocean stirred by hot water.

shloka_text: ततो ऽब्रवीदृशग्रीवः क्रुद्धः संरक्तलोचनः । कल्प्यतां मे रथः शीघ्रं शूराः सज्जीभवन्तु नः ।। 7.25.30 ।।
transliteration: tato 'bravīdṛśagrīvaḥ kruddhaḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ | kalpyatāṃ me rathaḥ śīghraṃ śūrāḥ sajjībhavantu naḥ || 7.25.30 ||
translation: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Ravana, क्रुद्धः enraged, संरक्तलोचनः with reddened eyes, कल्प्यताम् let it be prepared, मे my, रथः chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, शूराः brave warriors, सज्जीभवन्तु let them be ready, नः our.
explanation: Then, Ravana, enraged and with reddened eyes, spoke, saying, "Let my chariot be prepared quickly, and let our brave warriors be ready."

shloka_text: भ्राता मे कुम्भकर्णश्च ये च मुख्या निशाचराः । वाहनान्यधिरोहन्तु नानाप्रहरणायुधाः ।। 7.25.31 ।।
transliteration: bhrātā me kumbhakarṇaśca ye ca mukhyā niśācarāḥ | vāhanānyadhirohantu nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ || 7.25.31 ||
translation: भ्राता brother, मे my, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, च and, ये who, च and, मुख्याः chief, निशाचराः demons, वाहनानि mounts, अधिरोहन्तु let them mount, नानाप्रहरणायुधाः armed with various weapons.
explanation: My brother Kumbhakarna and the other chief demons, armed with various weapons, should mount their vehicles.

shloka_text: अद्य तं समरे हत्वा मधुं रावणनिर्भयम् । सुरलोकं गमिष्यामि युद्धकाङ्क्षी सुहृद्वृतः ।। 7.25.32 ।।
transliteration: adya taṃ samare hatvā madhuṃ rāvaṇanirbhayam | suralokaṃ gamiṣyāmi yuddhakāṅkṣī suhṛdvṛtaḥ || 7.25.32 ||
translation: अद्य today, तम् him, समरे in battle, हत्वा having killed, मधुम् Madhu, रावणनिर्भयम् fearless of Ravana, सुरलोकम् to the world of gods, गमिष्यामि I shall go, युद्धकाङ्क्षी desirous of battle, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends.
explanation: Today, having killed Madhu in battle, who is fearless of Ravana, I shall go to the world of gods, desirous of battle and surrounded by my friends.

shloka_text: अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणि चत्वार्यग्र्याणि रक्षसाम् । नानाप्रहरणान्याशु निर्ययुर्युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।। 7.25.33 ।।
transliteration: akṣauhiṇīsahasrāṇi catvāryagryāṇi rakṣasām | nānāpraharaṇānyāśu niryayuryuddhakāṅkṣiṇām || 7.25.33 ||
translation: अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणि thousands of Akshauhinis, चत्वारि four, अग्र्याणि foremost, रक्षसाम् of demons, नानाप्रहरणानि with various weapons, आशु quickly, निर्ययुः set out, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् desirous of battle.
explanation: Four thousand foremost Akshauhinis of demons, armed with various weapons and eager for battle, quickly set out.

shloka_text: इन्द्रजित्त्वग्रतः (अग्रतः) सैन्यात्सैनिकान्परिगृह्य च । जगाम रावणो मध्ये कुम्भकर्णश्च पृष्ठतः ।। 7.25.34 ।।
transliteration: indrajittvagrataḥ (agrataḥ) sainyātsainikānparigṛhya ca | jagāma rāvaṇo madhye kumbhakarṇaśca pṛṣṭhataḥ || 7.25.34 ||
translation: इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, तु and, अग्रतः in front, सैन्यात् from the army, सैनिकान् soldiers, परिगृह्य having gathered, च and, जगाम went, रावणः Ravana, मध्ये in the middle, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, च and, पृष्ठतः at the back.
explanation: Indrajit led the army from the front, Ravana marched in the middle, and Kumbhakarna followed at the rear.

shloka_text: विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा लङ्कायां धर्मामाचरत् । शोषाः सर्वे महाभागा ययुर्मधुपुरं प्रति ।। 7.25.35 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā laṅkāyāṃ dharmāmācarat | śoṣāḥ sarve mahābhāgā yayurmadhupuraṃ prati || 7.25.35 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, लङ्कायां in Lanka, धर्मम् righteousness, आचरत् practiced, शेषाः the remaining ones, सर्वे all, महाभागाः illustrious ones, ययुः went, मधुपुरं to Madhupura, प्रति towards.
explanation: The righteous Vibhishana remained in Lanka practicing dharma, while all the other illustrious remaining ones went towards Madhupura.

shloka_text: खरैरुष्ट्रैर्हयैर्दीप्तैः शिंशुमारैर्महोरगैः । राक्षसाः प्रययुः सर्वे कृत्वा ऽ ऽकाशं निरन्तरम् ।। 7.25.36 ।।
transliteration: kharairuṣṭrairhayairdīptaiḥ śiṃśumārairmahoragaiḥ | rākṣasāḥ prayayuḥ sarve kṛtvā ' 'kāśaṃ nirantaram || 7.25.36 ||
translation: खरैः with donkeys, उष्ट्रैः with camels, हयैः with horses, दीप्तैः splendid, शिंशुमारैः with porpoises, महोरगैः with great serpents, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, प्रययुः went forth, सर्वे all, कृत्वा having made, आकाशं the sky, निरन्तरम् completely filled.
explanation: All the Rakshasas set forth, mounted on donkeys, camels, splendid horses, porpoises, and great serpents, completely filling the sky.

shloka_text: दैत्याश्च शतशस्तत्र कृतवैराश्च दैवतैः । रावणं प्रेक्ष्य गच्छन्तमन्वगच्छन्हि पृष्ठतः ।। 7.25.37 ।।
transliteration: daityāśca śataśastatra kṛtavairāśca daivataiḥ | rāvaṇaṃ prekṣya gacchantamanvagacchanhi pṛṣṭhataḥ || 7.25.37 ||
translation: दैत्याः Daityas, च and, शतशः by hundreds, तत्र there, कृतवैराः who had enmity, च and, दैवतैः with the gods, रावणं Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, गच्छन्तम् going, अन्वगच्छन् followed, हि indeed, पृष्ठतः from behind.
explanation: Hundreds of Daityas, who had long-standing enmity with the gods, saw Ravana going and indeed followed him from behind.

shloka_text: स तु गत्वा मधुपुरं प्रविश्य च दशाननः । न ददर्श मधुं तत्र भगिनीं तत्र दृष्टवान् ।। 7.25.38 ।।
transliteration: sa tu gatvā madhupuraṃ praviśya ca daśānanaḥ | na dadarśa madhuṃ tatra bhaginīṃ tatra dṛṣṭavān || 7.25.38 ||
translation: सः He, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, मधुपुरं to Madhupura, प्रविश्य having entered, च and, दशाननः Ravana, न not, ददर्श saw, मधुं Madhu, तत्र there, भगिनीं his sister, तत्र there, दृष्टवान् saw.
explanation: Having gone to Madhupura and entered it, Ravana did not find Madhu there, but instead saw his sister.

shloka_text: सा च प्रह्वाञ्जलिर्भूत्वा शिरसा चरणौ गता ।। 7.25.39 ।।
transliteration: sā ca prahvāñjalirbhūtvā śirasā caraṇau gatā || 7.25.39 ||
translation: सा she, च and, प्रह्वाञ्जलिर्भूत्वा having become humble with folded hands, शिरसा with her head, चरणौ (his) feet, गता reached.
explanation: And she, becoming humble with folded hands, touched his feet with her head.

shloka_text: तस्य राक्षसराजस्य त्रस्ता कुम्भीनसी तदा । तां समुत्थापयामास न भेतव्यमिति ब्रुवन् ।। 7.25.40 ।।
transliteration: tasya rākṣasarājasya trastā kumbhīnasī tadā | tāṃ samutthāpayāmāsa na bhetavyamiti bruvan || 7.25.40 ||
translation: तस्य of that, राक्षसराजस्य king of Rakshasas, त्रस्ता frightened, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, तदा then, ताम् her, समुत्थापयामास made to rise, न not, भेतव्यम् to be feared, इति thus, ब्रुवन् saying.
explanation: Then, Kumbhinasi, frightened by that king of Rakshasas, made her rise, saying, "You should not be afraid."

shloka_text: रावणो राक्षसश्रेष्ठः किं चापि करवाणि ते । साब्रवीद्यदि मे राजन्प्रसन्नस्त्वं महाभुज । भर्तारं न ममेहाद्य हन्तुर्महसि मानद ।। 7.25.41 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇo rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ kiṃ cāpi karavāṇi te | sābravīdyadi me rājanprasannastvaṃ mahābhuja | bhartāraṃ na mamehādya hanturmahasi mānada || 7.25.41 ||
translation: रावणो Ravana, राक्षसश्रेष्ठः O best of Rakshasas, किम् what, च and, अपि also, करवाणि shall I do, ते for you? साब्रवीत् she said, यदि if, मे to me, राजन् O king, प्रसन्नस्त्वम् you are pleased, महाभुज O mighty-armed one, भर्तारम् husband, न not, मम my, इह here, अद्य today, हन्तुम् to kill, अर्हसि you ought, मानद O giver of honor.
explanation: Ravana, O best of Rakshasas, asked, "What else shall I do for you?" She replied, "If you are pleased with me, O king, O mighty-armed one, O giver of honor, then you should not kill my husband here today."

shloka_text: न हीदृशं भयं किञ्चित्कुलस्त्रीणामिहोच्यते । भयानामपि सर्वेषां वैधव्यं व्यसनं महत् ।। 7.25.42 ।।
transliteration: na hīdṛśaṃ bhayaṃ kiñcitkulastrīṇāmihocyate | bhayānāmapi sarveṣāṃ vaidhavyaṃ vyasanaṃ mahat || 7.25.42 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, ईदृशम् such, भयम् fear, किञ्चित् any, कुलस्त्रीणाम् for noble women, इह here, उच्यते is said. भयानाम् of fears, अपि even, सर्वेषाम् all, वैधव्यम् widowhood, व्यसनम् calamity, महत् great.
explanation: Indeed, no such fear is spoken of for noble women in this world, for among all fears, widowhood is the greatest calamity.

shloka_text: सत्यवाग्भव राजेन्द्र मामवेक्षस्व याचतीम् । त्वयाप्युक्तं महाराज न भेतव्यमिति स्वयम् ।। 7.25.43 ।।
transliteration: satyavāgbhava rājendra māmavekṣasva yācatīm | tvayāpyuktaṃ mahārāja na bhetavyamiti svayam || 7.25.43 ||
translation: सत्यवाग्भव be truthful in speech, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, माम् me, अवेक्षस्व consider, याचतीम् who is begging. त्वयापि by you also, उक्तम् was said, महाराज O great king, न not, भेतव्यम् to be feared, इति thus, स्वयम् yourself.
explanation: O king of kings, be truthful in your word and consider me, who is begging, for you yourself, O great king, said, "You should not be afraid."

shloka_text: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टः स्वसारं तत्र संस्थिताम् । क्व चासौ तव भर्ता वै मम शीघ्रं निवेद्यताम् ।। 7.25.44 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastvabravīddhṛṣṭaḥ svasāraṃ tatra saṃsthitām | kva cāsau tava bhartā vai mama śīghraṃ nivedyatām || 7.25.44 ||
translation: रावणः Ravana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् said, धृष्टः impudent, स्वसारं to his sister, तत्र there, संस्थिताम् standing, क्व where, च and, असौ that, तव your, भर्ता husband, वै indeed, मम to me, शीघ्रं quickly, निवेद्यताम् let him be reported.
explanation: Impudent Ravana said to his sister, who was standing there, "Where is your husband? Show him to me quickly."

shloka_text: सह तेन गमिष्यामि सुरलोकं जयावहे । तव कारुण्यसौहार्दान्निवृत्तो ऽस्मि मधोर्वधात् ।। 7.25.45 ।।
transliteration: saha tena gamiṣyāmi suralokaṃ jayāvahe | tava kāruṇyasauhārdānnivṛtto 'smi madhorvadhāt || 7.25.45 ||
translation: सह with, तेन him, गमिष्यामि I shall go, सुरलोकं to the world of gods, जयावहे for victory, तव your, कारुण्यसौहार्दात् due to compassion and friendship, निवृत्तः stopped, अस्मि I am, मधोः of Madhu, वधात् from killing.
explanation: I will go with him to conquer the world of the gods, and because of your compassion and friendship, I have refrained from killing Madhu.

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता सा समुत्थाप्य प्रसुप्तं तं निशाचरम् । अब्रवीत्सम्प्रहृष्टेव राक्षसी सा पतिं वचः ।। 7.25.46 ।।
transliteration: ityuktā sā samutthāpya prasuptaṃ taṃ niśācaram | abravītsamprahṛṣṭeva rākṣasī sā patiṃ vacaḥ || 7.25.46 ||
translation: इति thus, उक्ता addressed, सा she, समुत्थाप्य having awakened, प्रसुप्तं sleeping, तं that, निशाचरम् night-wanderer, अब्रवीत् spoke, सम्प्रहृष्टा as if greatly delighted, राक्षसी the female demon, सा she, पतिं to her husband, वचः words.
explanation: Thus addressed, she, the female demon, awakened her sleeping husband, the night-wanderer, and spoke words to him as if greatly delighted.

shloka_text: एष प्राप्तो दशग्रीवो मम भ्राता महाबलः । सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी साहाय्ये त्वां वृणोति च ।। 7.25.47 ।।
transliteration: eṣa prāpto daśagrīvo mama bhrātā mahābalaḥ | suralokajayākāṅkṣī sāhāyye tvāṃ vṛṇoti ca || 7.25.47 ||
translation: एषः this, प्राप्तः arrived, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, मम my, भ्राता brother, महाबलः very powerful, सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी desirous of conquering the world of gods, साहाय्ये for help, त्वां you, वृणोति chooses, च and.
explanation: My very powerful brother Dashagriva has arrived, desirous of conquering the world of the gods, and he requests your assistance.

shloka_text: तदस्य त्वं सहायार्थं सबन्धुर्गच्छ राक्षस । स्निग्धस्य भजमानस्य युक्तमर्थाय कल्पितुम् ।। 7.25.48 ।।
transliteration: tadasya tvaṃ sahāyārthaṃ sabandhurgaccha rākṣasa | snigdhasya bhajamānasya yuktamarthāya kalpitum || 7.25.48 ||
translation: तत् therefore, अस्य his, त्वं you, सहायार्थं for the purpose of help, सबन्धुः with your relatives, गच्छ go, राक्षस O Rakshasa, स्निग्धस्य of an affectionate one, भजमानस्य who seeks (help), युक्तम् it is proper, अर्थाय for the purpose, कल्पितुम् to provide.
explanation: Therefore, O Rakshasa, you should go with your relatives to help him, for it is proper to provide assistance to an affectionate one who seeks it.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तथेत्याह मधुर्वचः ।। 7.25.49 ।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā tathetyāha madhurvacaḥ || 7.25.49 ||
translation: तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, तथा so be it, इति thus, आह said, मधुः Madhu, वचः words.
explanation: Having heard her words, Madhu replied, "So be it."

shloka_text: ददर्श राक्षसश्रेष्ठं यथान्यायमुपेत्य सः । पूजयमास धर्मेण रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।। 7.25.50 ।।
transliteration: dadarśa rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ yathānyāyamupetya saḥ | pūjayamāsa dharmeṇa rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam || 7.25.50 ||
translation: ददर्श he saw, राक्षसश्रेष्ठं the best of Rakshasas, यथान्यायम् according to custom, उपेत्य having approached, सः he, पूजयमास worshipped, धर्मेण righteously, रावणं Ravana, राक्षसाधिपम् the lord of Rakshasas.
explanation: He approached Ravana, the best and lord of Rakshasas, and worshipped him according to custom and righteousness.

shloka_text: प्राप्य पूजां दशग्रीवो मधुवेश्मानि वीर्यवान् । तत्र चैकां निशामुष्य गमनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.25.51 ।।
transliteration: prāpya pūjāṃ daśagrīvo madhuveśmāni vīryavān | tatra caikāṃ niśāmuṣya gamanāyopacakrame || 7.25.51 ||
translation: प्राप्य having received, पूजां worship, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), मधुवेश्मानि in Madhu's abode, वीर्यवान् the powerful one, तत्र there, च and, एकाम् one, निशाम् night, उष्य having stayed, गमनाय for departure, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: The powerful Ravana, having received worship in Madhu's abode and stayed there for one night, then prepared for his departure.

shloka_text: ततः कैलासमासाद्य शैलं वैश्रवणालयम् । राक्षसेन्द्रो महेन्द्राभः सेनामुपनिवेशयत् ।। 7.25.52 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kailāsamāsādya śailaṃ vaiśravaṇālayam | rākṣasendro mahendrābhaḥ senāmupaniveśayat || 7.25.52 ||
translation: ततः then, कैलासम् Kailasa, आसाद्य having reached, शैलं mountain, वैश्रवणालयम् the abode of Vaishravana (Kubera), राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, महेन्द्राभः resembling Mahendra (Indra), सेनाम् army, उपनिवेशयत् encamped.
explanation: Then, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, who resembled Mahendra, reached Mount Kailasa, the abode of Kubera, and encamped his army there.
